Unfortunately, I have been unable to retrieve the specific content for Chapter 5 describing the climate adaptation case study. All attempts to directly fetch book excerpts have only returned the introduction (Chapter 1), and a subsequent focused web search did not yield the detailed case study content outside of the book itself.

The best summary obtained mentions the case study specifically:

> "The climate adaptation case study in Chapter 5 demonstrates the framework's practical reach." (From a review in the *Journal of Policy Analysis and Management*).

Based on the context from Chapter 1, this case study details the application of the **Adaptive Policy Envelope Design (APED)** framework to **climate adaptation in coastal infrastructure**. To cover this in detail for your seminar, you will need access to the physical text or alternative digital access to Chapter 5 of the monograph.
